phase1_c1_vs_c2_gate.aggregation_correction: the -17.89pp pooled BABILong figure is a mean over 9 cells with OPPOSITE true signs (4 sig negative, 2 sig POSITIVE, 3 n.s.). Pooling summarises nothing. Report per-cell always. This is exactly the aggregation artifact A01's null-calibration protocol exists to catch.
phase1_c1_vs_c2_gate.no_clean_c2_advantage: There is NO protocol-clean benchmark on which C2 is significantly better in aggregate. The only such leg was the quarantined LoCoMo judge.
phase1_c1_vs_c2_gate.prescribed_reframe: Position CoMem as a storage / read-compute method for high-reuse workloads, NOT a quality win. This is what the kill clause literally instructs.
phase1_c1_vs_c2_gate.reframe_NOT_supported: Do NOT reframe as 'C2 worse at exact-match, better at semantic'. qa5 lives INSIDE BABILong, a synthetic exact-match benchmark, so that split does not carve the data. The honest axis is single-span retrieval (C2 loses badly at long context) vs multi-mention relation (C2 can win), and that needs more than 2 significant cells to assert.
